newsitem.title: USA: CSCE to raise margins on cocoa futures June 18.
newsitem.headline: CSCE to raise margins on cocoa futures June 18.

text.p: Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange said Tuesday it will raise margins on the July 1997 and September 1997 cocoa contracts by $100, to $600, including no spot charge, effective June 18.
The margin on all other coffee contracts will be increased by $100, to $600, the exchange said in a statement.
For customers who are not exchange members or a member of the trade, margins will be 140 percent above trade rates, CSCE said. ((--Patricia Avidan, New York Commodities Desk, 212 859 1640))
